name: Adoption
overview: The Scriptures reveal adoption as a profound expression of God's provision and blessing, illustrated in the Old Testament through examples such as Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh, whom Israel claimed as his own heirs, granting them a special portion above their brethren. This act of adoption not only confers inheritance but also carries the weight of God's name and blessing, as seen when Israel invokes the Angel who redeemed him to bless the lads. Additionally, the story of Moses being found and taken in by Pharaoh's daughter highlights God's sovereign hand in placing adopted children into positions of purpose and care. Together, these passages demonstrate adoption as a divinely orchestrated means of inclusion, inheritance, and blessing within God's covenant family.
